evals.prompt: Run a full dependency audit of this repo — I want to see how the packages depend on each other, what's heavy, and what we should fix first.
evals.expected_output: Runs collect-deps.mjs, writes reports/dependencies/<date>.md following the template (sections 1–8), and replies with the path, TL;DR, finding counts and a P0/P1 table.
assertions: A1: Ran scripts/collect-deps.mjs rather than estimating sizes by hand (du/ls guesses don't count)
A2: Report covers all six packages: server, client, reviewer-core, e2e, mcp-server, evals
A3: Mermaid map has internal alias edges server→reviewer-core (@devdigest/reviewer-core) and reviewer-core/mcp-server→shared (@devdigest/shared)
A4: Flags the client vs server @devdigest/shared vendored copies as out of sync, rated P0, naming differing files
A5: e2e is reported as not installed / not measured — no invented sizes
A6: Recommendations table has ID, priority, package, evidence with numbers, concrete per-manager command (pnpm -C / npm --prefix), effort, risk
A7: @fastify/autoload in server is verified with Grep and reported as unused (modules are registered statically)
A8: Does not run install/remove/update or audit fix

evals.prompt: Why is client/node_modules so big? What's actually worth trimming?
evals.expected_output: Scoped answer about client only: prod closure vs dev-only vs node_modules totals, heaviest deps by closure (next, mermaid, lucide-react…), the disk-size≠bundle-size caveat, and only realistic trims (e.g. lazy-loading mermaid) — no 'replace Next.js'.
assertions: C1: Numbers come from collect-deps.mjs output (closure sizes for next and mermaid)
C2: Scoped to client — no recommendations for other packages
C3: States that on-disk size is not bundle size
C4: Does not recommend replacing next/react as a size fix
C5: Distinguishes prod closure from dev-only weight

evals.prompt: Check the dependencies of this repo (two packages, api and web) and tell me what to fix, in priority order.
evals.expected_output: P0: zod 4.x (api) vs 3.x (web) across the shared @acme/shared contract; P0: vendored src/vendor/shared/index.ts differs (currency enum UAH only in api); P1: @types/express in api dependencies; P1: left-pad unused in api.
assertions: P1: Flags zod major mismatch (4.x in api, 3.x in web) as a shared-contract risk, rated P0
P2: Flags the vendored @acme/shared copies as diverged (index.ts — 'UAH' currency only in api), rated P0
P3: Flags @types/express listed under dependencies instead of devDependencies, rated P1
P4: Flags left-pad as unused in api after verifying with Grep, rated P1
P5: Uses pnpm for api and npm for web in suggested commands
